prompt: Turn an Optional<Config> into a validated port number with a single map/filter chain: digits only, parsed to int, and within 1-65535. Complete parsePort in Chained, then run the tests.
explanation: Optional.map transforms a present value and -- crucially -- turns a null mapping result into an empty Optional, which is why a Config holding a null value flows harmlessly through the chain. filter keeps a present value only when the predicate passes, otherwise the Optional collapses to empty and every later step is skipped. Validating the digits BEFORE Integer.parseInt is what keeps the chain exception-free.
hints: Start with cfg.map(Config::value) to unwrap the raw string.
Filter the raw string against a digits-only regular expression BEFORE parsing, so parseInt can never throw.
